paraphrase: Voidness (suññatā) — the mind void of 'I' and 'mine' — is the heartwood of the teaching; one should work with a void mind and offer the fruits of work to voidness.
translation_basis: paraphrase made by the unit author from the Pali where the passage was read locally; otherwise from the author's knowledge of the text
